title: Ilaiya ilaiya
body:
ILLAIYA ILLAIYA YA BUNAIYA X2
EH SAKINA MERE PASS AAJA X2
LAASH E BESAR SE AWAAZ AAYAI
TUJKO BETI BULATA HAI BABA
UTH RAHI HAI KABI GIRH RAHI HAI

EH SAKINA………

MERI NAZRO MEI TU FATIMA HAI

AAJ KHAALI NAHI MERA SINA AAKE BABA KE PEHLU MEI SOJAA

WO TAMACHE TUJE MAAR TA THA
KOI TERI MADDAT KO NA AAYA
SU EH DARIYA NA JAANA EH BETI
TUJSE SHAMINDA HAI TERA SAKKA
KARBALA SE TAKKALUM YEH BIBI
SHAAM KE KADH KHAANE MEI POHCHI
EK SHAB THA KEYAMAT KA MANZAR
KHAAK SE WO YEH KEH KAR JO UTTHI
ALWIDA ALWIDA KUNBEH WAALO
